Subject: Request: short outcomes quote for renewal + expansion

Hi Jared / Priya —

Quick ask as we move toward the renewal + Dedicated capacity addendum: would BrightFin be comfortable providing a short outcomes quote (1–2 sentences) we can use in a customer reference / case study? We want something that highlights the measurable impact of Redwood on your product metrics — e.g., latency, cost per inference, or business conversion changes.

I attached a first-pass case study draft and a mutual action plan that shows the timeline for the Dedicated rollout and the contract update. If youre open to it, a single sentence like “Redwood reduced our average inference latency from X to Y and cut per-request cost by Z%, enabling…” would be perfect.

Attachments: brightfin_case_study_draft.pdf (draft), mutual_action_plan.xlsx (MAP)

Were planning to publish the case study alongside the renewal announcement if youre OK — we can anonymize numbers if needed. If you prefer, feel free to reply with the exact language youd like us to use.

Thanks,

Neha Kapoor

Subject: Re: Request: short outcomes quote for renewal + expansion

Neha —

Thanks for sending along the draft. BrightFin is happy to be a reference and to provide a short quote. High-level outcomes wed be comfortable naming publicly: after migrating inference to Redwoods runtime and enabling prefix caching, our 95th-percentile inference latency dropped from ~220ms to ~85ms, and our inference unit cost fell ~42%. That latency improvement directly improved our user-side model interaction completion rate (roughly +7 percentage points).

Suggested short quote you can use: "Redwood cut our inference latency by over 60% and reduced per-request cost significantly — the result was faster experiences for our users and measurable lift in completion rates."

You have BrightFins permission to use the quote above and our corporate logo. Please credit it to Jared Cole, Head of Engineering, BrightFin.

Ill loop in Priya for procurement on the addendum — were aiming to finalize legal next week.

Best,

Jared Cole
Head of Engineering | BrightFin, Inc.
jared.cole@brightfin.com | +1 646-555-0182

Jared — really appreciate the quick reply and the clear metrics, thats perfect.

Marcus / Laura: could you validate the latency/cost figures against our telemetry before we lock these in? Marcus, if we can attach the small chart you made (95th pct latency and cost delta) thats helpful for the comms doc.

Jared — two small asks before we publish: 1) can you confirm youre okay with the headline variant: "BrightFin speeds model responses 60% faster while cutting inference costs 40%+"? 2) if possible, please provide a one-line customer-facing name you want used (e.g., Jared Cole, Head of Engineering) — you already stated this but want explicit permission for publication.

Ill hold off on publishing until we have confirmation. Thanks again.

—Neha
